title: quantyra-null-cone-lean: finite causal-order rank rigidity
description:
Lean 4 proof of finite realizer rank rigidity: for every two-order realizer of an occupied-grid sample, one global axis exchange gives both interior rank errors at most 30rn under explicit marginal and boundary hypotheses.

The accompanying draft preprint derives d_conf <= 100 (N^(-1/12) + Delta_N) for a restricted smooth positive uniform-marginal density class in a two-dimensional conformal diamond. Only the deterministic finite theorem is Lean verified. Probability, continuous-density interpolation and proper-time comparisons remain prose proofs. Novelty and independent review are unconfirmed; no general spacetime reconstruction, new physical law, curvature estimate or carrying-capacity benefit is claimed.
